caption:
Korean Braised Potato 
vegan delights | quick recipe | low prep | meal prep friendly 

Nutrition: 
C: 57 | F: 2 | P: 7
Calories: 267 per serve
Serves 3

Ingredients
4 potatoes, peeled and cubed
1 tsp sesame oil or olive oil
1 tbsp soy sauce
1 1/2  tbsp gochujang
1/2 tsp gochugara
1 tsp vinegar
1/2 cup water
1 tsp honey to top with after cooking ( as many people believe you should not heat honey but the flavour is banging )

garnish
spring onion + white sesame seeds

Method 
boil the cubed potatoes if you want ( i do this to reduce cooking time, but you can choose not to which will add 10-15 minutes of cooking time and you need to add more water to the braising liquid 
in a pan add oil then add in the potatoes, saute till you get a little colour 
add in the braising liquid and cover ( stir every few minutes )
once you feel the potatoes are cooked ( they still need to have a bite, we dont want mushy potatoes ), 
top with sesame seeds and green spring onions and enjoy :)
i serve this with steamed rice and fresh cut cucumbers, makes the perfect meal!
